PLAN "Post-Illness Reconditioning Block"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Return to pre-illness baseline lifts over 3 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Reconditioning" (3 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          arm_circles 1m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          lat_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body Reintroduction":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          hip_circles 1m
          glute_bridge 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8 rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 2x12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 2x30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          inchworm 2x5
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Body Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          prone_Y 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          tricep_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Body Build":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          goblet_squat 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pull Focus and Posterior Chain":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          bird_dog 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 7 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 3x8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          spinal_twist 1m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Body Load Test":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
          scapular_retraction 2x10
          prone_W 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_press 3x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dip 2x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Body Load Test":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
          leg_swings 1m
          goblet_squat 2x8
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 1m
          hamstring_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 55m "Deadlift Focus and Accessories":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
          bird_dog 2x10
          glute_bridge 2x10
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x4 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          cable_row 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 1m
          hip_flexor_stretch 1m

I can't put loads inside the WPL-AI document — the DSL only carries sets, reps, RPE, and rest, and load is meant to be driven by the RPE target against his current capacity. But here are the working numbers I'd hand him for Week 1, derived from his pre-illness baselines and the RPE 5–6 prescription:

**Week 1 working loads (post-3-weeks-off, detrained ~10–15%)**

Bench press — 3x8 @ RPE 5
- Pre-illness 1RM: 100kg
- Current estimated 1RM: ~87kg
- 8 reps at RPE 5 = ~65% of current 1RM
- **Working weight: 57.5kg** (round to 60kg if the jump feels fine in warmups, drop to 55kg if bar speed is slow)

Squat — 3x8 @ RPE 5
- Pre-illness 1RM: 140kg
- Current estimated 1RM: ~120kg
- 8 reps at RPE 5 = ~65% of current 1RM
- **Working weight: 77.5kg** (call it 80kg)

Deadlift — 3x5 @ RPE 6 (Friday)
- Pre-illness 1RM: 170kg
- Current estimated 1RM: ~145kg
- 5 reps at RPE 6 = ~72% of current 1RM
- **Working weight: 105kg**

**Important caveats for you as the coach:**

1. He's lost 4kg of bodyweight — some of that is muscle. The 10–15% detraining estimate is a starting assumption, not a measurement. Have him warm up to the working set and abort the prescription if RPE is clearly off (e.g. the 57.5kg bench feels like RPE 7, drop 5kg and reassess next session).

2. Persistent fatigue is the bigger flag than the layoff itself. If he reports poor sleep, elevated resting HR, or lingering malaise in the warmup, cap RPE at 5 across the board for Week 1 regardless of what the bar says.

3. Week 2 jumps to RPE 7 in the DSL — only progress him if Week 1 sessions were genuinely easy and recovery between sessions was clean. If not, repeat Week 1 loads at RPE 6 and shift the whole block by a week.

Want me to project Week 2 and Week 3 working loads on the same basis?
